title: Fabrication of a Corneal Epithelial Cell Sheet from Human Pluripotent Stem Cells by a Method Based on Spontaneous Ocular Cell Differentiation
protocol: Supplement GMEM with 10% knockout serum replacement, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 0.1 mM non-essential amino acids, 2 mM L-glutamine, and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin solution.
Add 55 µM 2-mercaptoethanol or Monothioglycerol to the differentiation medium (DM).
Combine DM with CnT-PR without EGF and FGF2 in a 1:1 ratio for corneal differentiation medium (CDM), supplementing with 20 ng/ml KGF and 10 µM Y-27632.
Mix DMEM/F12 in a 1:1 ratio to prepare corneal epithelium maintenance medium (CEM) and add 2% B-27, 20 ng/ml KGF, and 10 µM Y-27632.

Prepare KCM medium by supplementing DMEM without glutamine with Nutrient Mixture F-12 Ham (3:1), 5% FBS, 0.4 µg/ml hydrocortisone succinate, 2 nM triiodo-L-thyronine sodium salt, 1 nM cholera toxin, 2.25 µg/ml bovine transferrin HOLO form, and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin solution.
Add 20 ng/ml KGF and 10 µM Y-27632 to KCM medium for corneal epithelium-maturation medium (CMM).
Culture hiPSCs (clone 201B7) in StemFit medium on LN511E8-coated 6-well culture plates.
Coat plates with LN511E8.
Coat new 6-well culture plates with LN511E8 at 0.5 µg/cm² in 1.5 ml PBS by incubation at 37°C for at least 60 min.
Add 0.7 ml StemFit™ medium to the culture plates.
Remove the mixed solution.
Immediately add 1.5 ml StemFit™ medium containing 10 µM Y-27632 and incubate at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
Remove the medium.
Wash hiPSCs once with 1 ml PBS.
Add 300 µl dissociation solution (50% TrypLE select and 50% 0.5 mM EDTA solution) and incubate for 4-5 min at 37°C.
Remove the dissociation solution carefully (hiPSCs are still attached to the culture plates).
Wash the hiPSCs once with 2 ml PBS, then add 1 ml StemFit™ medium containing 10 µM Y-27632.
Harvest the hiPSCs with a Cell Scraper.
Pipette the hiPSCs about 10 times with a 200 or 1000µL micropipette and then harvest the dissociated hiPSCs in a 1.5 ml tube.
Count the collected hiPSCs using a Countess® Machine after staining with Trypan blue (settings for Countess®: Sensitivity: 5, Minimum size: 8, Maximum size: 30, Circularity: 75).
Seed hiPSCs on LN511E8 coated 6-well culture plates at 13,000 cells/well.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
The next day, change the medium to fresh StemFit™ medium without Y-27632 and incubate at 37°C in 5% CO₂ up to day seven. The medium change should be performed every two days.
Coat a 6-well or 12-well culture plate with LN511E8 at 0.5 µg/cm².
Harvest hiPSCs using the same method as for hiPSC passaging.
Seed dissociated hiPSCs on 6-well plates at 3000-6000 cells/well or on 12-well plates at 1000-2000 cells/well in StemFit™ medium containing 10 µM Y-27632.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
Change the medium to fresh StemFit™ medium without Y-27632 the next day.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in 5% CO₂ for 10 days total, changing the medium every two days before day seven and daily thereafter.
After 10 days culture in StemFit™ medium, change the medium to DM (Day 0).
Incubate the plates at 37°C in 5% CO₂ for four weeks, changing the medium every 2-3 days.
Change the medium to 2 ml of CDM after four weeks of incubation in DM.
Incubate the plates for an additional four weeks at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
Change the medium every 2-3 days during the additional four-week period.
Optionally, change the medium to CEM at day 28 and incubate for an additional 2-3 weeks.
Perform manual pipetting using PIPETMAN™ (1000 or 200 µl) on a clean bench after three weeks of CDM culture.
Change the medium containing detached cells to fresh CDM after pipetting.
Incubate the plates for an additional one week in CDM (i.e., eight weeks in total).
Change the medium to 2 ml (6-well plate) of CEM after four weeks of CDM culture (i.e., eight weeks overall).
Incubate the plates for at least two weeks (i.e., 10 weeks in total) to a maximum of eight weeks (i.e., 16 weeks in total) at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Change the medium every 2-3 days (three times per week).
Wash the hiPSCs once with PBS after CEM culture.
Add Accutase™ to the differentiated hiPSCs and incubate for 45 min at 37°C.
Perform pipetting several times and again incubate for 15 min at 37°C.
Collect and re-suspend the dissociated cells in ice-cold KCM medium in a STEMFULL™ 15 ml tube.
Filter the cells using a Cell Strainer (40 µm) and count the cell number.
Centrifuge the cells at 1200 rpm for 8 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and re-suspend the cells in ice-cold KCM containing FITC-conjugated SSEA-4, PE-conjugated CD104, and Alexa647-conjugated TRA-1-60 antibodies.
Incubate the cells for 1 hr at 4°C (agitate the cells every 20 min).
Wash the cells twice with PBS.
Resuspend the cells in PBS by filtration using a Cell strainer (40 µm).
Stain the cells with non-specific isotype IgG for SSEA-4 and CD104 or IgM for TRA-1-60 as controls.
Prepare single-color stained cells for each fluorescent probe for color compensation during flow cytometry.
Set up the FACSAriaII machine.
Subject stained cells to sorting in the FACSAriaII.
Perform compensation between detectors for FITC, PE, and Alexa647 using single-stained cells.
Analyze the triple-color stained cells.
Sort the SSEA-4+, CD104+, TRA-1-60- population (hiCEC fraction) to 8 ml of KCM in a STEMFULLTM 15 ml tube.
Collect the hiCECs by centrifugation at 1200 rpm for 8 min.
Resuspend the cells in CEM on ice.

Coat a 6-well UpCell® plate (for corneal epithelial transplantation) or a 12-well culture insert (for promoting differentiation or long-term culture) with LN511E8 at 0.5-1.0 mg/cm² by incubation at 37°C for at least 60 min.
Seed FACS-sorted SSEA-4+, CD104+, TRA-1-60- cells (hiCECs) on the 6-well UpCell® plate at 1.5-6.0 x 10^5 cells/well or on the 12-well culture inserts at 0.5-1.0 x 10^5 cells/well in CEM.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 5-12 days until confluence.
Change the medium every two days during incubation.
After reaching confluence, change the medium to CMM.
Incubate the cells in CMM for 3-10 days at 37°C in 5% CO2 to allow stratification.
Change the medium every two days during stratification.
Incubate the UpCell® plate at 20°C for 30 min.
Place the PVDF membrane on the cell sheet as a carrier.
Harvest the cell sheet using tweezers.
For long-term culture, continue to incubate the cells in CEM.
Maintain the cells for at least 10 weeks.
To promote maturation of cells, change the medium to CMM and incubate for an additional 3-10 days.
